# WellSource — Health & Wellness Blog

## Overview

Build the homepage for **WellSource**, a trusted health and wellness media platform. Think WebMD meets a modern editorial blog — authoritative yet approachable. The audience is everyday consumers looking for reliable health information, so the design must immediately communicate **credibility and warmth** without feeling clinical or cold.

## Visual Direction

- **Color palette**: Use a calming, health-oriented scheme — soft teals/greens as primary, warm whites and light grays for backgrounds, with accents of coral or amber for CTAs. Avoid harsh reds or overly saturated colors.
- **Typography**: Clean, modern sans-serif (e.g., Inter, DM Sans, or similar) with strong hierarchy. Headlines should feel confident; body text should be highly readable at comfortable sizes.
- **Mood**: Professional but human. Generous whitespace, rounded corners on cards, subtle shadows. The page should feel like a well-organized magazine — content-rich without being overwhelming.

## Key Priorities

1. **Trust is everything.** The credibility stats ticker and trust pillars section are critical — these must feel prominent and polished. The scrolling ticker with stats like "130 medical reviewers" and "50 million monthly readers" should be eye-catching and smooth.

2. **The mega-menu navigation** is a core interaction. Each main nav item should expand a well-structured dropdown with subcategories. This is how users discover content — make it intuitive and visually clean.

3. **Recommended Reads tabs** are the primary interactive content discovery mechanism. The tab switching between categories (Top Reads, Fitness, Mental Well-Being, etc.) must feel snappy and seamless, updating the article grid below without page reload.

4. **Newsletter signup** should be visually compelling — this is a key conversion goal. Make the CTA section stand out with a contrasting background.

5. **Health topics carousel** should scroll smoothly with clear navigation arrows and attractive circular image cards.

Refer to `task_input.json` for the complete section list, all interaction specs, and detailed data content.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

[Caching Strategies](./references/turborepo-caching.md) - Local cache, remote cache, cache invalidation **RemixIcon References:** - [Integration Guide](./references/remix-icon-integration.md) - Installation, usage, customization, accessibility ## Common Patterns & Workflows ### Pattern 1: Full-Stack Monorepo ``` my-monorepo/ ├── apps/ │ ├── web/ # Customer-facing Next.js app │ ├── admin/ # Admin dashboard Next.js app │ └── docs/ # Documentation site ├── packages/ │ ├── ui/ # Shared UI with RemixIcon │ ├── api-client/ # API client library │ ├── config/ # ESLint, TypeScript configs │ └── types/ # Shared TypeScript types └── turbo.json # Build pipeline ``` **turbo.json:** ```json { "$schema": "https://turbo.build/schema.json", "pipeline": { "build": { "dependsOn": ["^build"], "outputs": [".next/**", "!.next/cache/**", "dist/**"] }, "dev": { "cache": false, "persistent": true }, "lint": {}, "test": { "dependsOn": ["build"] } } } ``` ### Pattern 2: Shared Component Library ```tsx // packages/ui/src/button.tsx import { RiLoader4Line } from "@remixicon/react" export function Button({ children, loading, icon }) { return ( ) } // apps/web/app/page.tsx import { Button } from "@repo/ui/button" import { RiHomeLine } from "@remixicon/react" export default function Page() { return } ``` ### Pattern 3: Optimized Data Fetching ```tsx // app/posts/[slug]/page.tsx import { notFound } from 'next/navigation' // Static generation at build time export async function generateStaticParams() { const posts = await getPosts() return posts.map(post => ({ slug: post.slug })) } // Revalidate every hour async function getPost(slug: string) { const res = await fetch(`https://api.example.com/posts/${slug}`, { next: { revalidate: 3600 } }) if (!res.ok) return null return res.json() } export default async function Post({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) { const post = await getPost(params.slug) if (!post) notFound() return
{post.content}
} ``` ### Pattern 4: Monorepo CI/CD Pipeline ```yaml # .github/workflows/ci.yml name: CI on: [push, pull_request] jobs: build: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v4 - uses: actions/setup-node@v4 with: node-version: 18 - Structure monorepo with clear separation (apps/, packages/) - Define task dependencies correctly (^build for topological) - Configure outputs for proper caching - Enable remote caching for team collaboration - Use filters to run tasks on changed packages only **RemixIcon:** - Use line style for minimal interfaces, fill for emphasis - Maintain 24x24 grid alignment for crisp rendering - Provide aria-labels for accessibility - 1	# WellSource — Expert health guidance you can trust
2	
3	## Brand
4	WellSource is a comprehensive health and wellness media platform delivering medically reviewed content, tools, and resources to empower informed health decisions. The tone is professional, modern, and warm — designed to build trust with general consumers seeking reliable health and wellness information.
5	
6	Brand colors: #02838D (teal/primary), #231F20 (dark charcoal), #FFFFFF (white)
7	
8	## Header Navigation
9	- **Health Conditions** — dropdown mega-menu with subcategories: Breast Cancer, Chronic Kidney Disease, COPD, Digestive Health, Eye Health, Heart Health, Menopause, Mental Health, Migraine, Multiple Sclerosis, Parkinson's Disease, Psoriasis, Rheumatoid Arthritis, Sleep Health, Type 2 Diabetes, Weight Management
10	- **Wellness** — dropdown with: CBD, Fitness, Healthy Aging, Hearing, Mental Well-Being, Nutrition, Parenthood, Recipes, Sexual Health, Skin Care, Sleep Health, Vitamins and Supplements, Women's Wellness; also Product Reviews and Featured Programs
11	- **Tools** — Pill Identifier, FindCare, Drugs A-Z, Medicare Plans by State, Lessons, Newsletters, Lifestyle Quizzes
12	- **Featured** — Health News, Top Reads, Video Series
13	- **Connect** — Bezzy community links, social media
14	
15	Secondary actions: Subscribe | Sign In
16	
17	## Credibility Stats
18	A continuously scrolling ticker bar displaying:
19	- Medically reviewed content
20	- 145 medical reviewers in network
21	- 21 years of experience
22	- 55 million monthly readers
23	
24	## Hero Content
25	Category label: Fitness
26	Title: "Day 12: Resistance Band Moves You Can Do in 10 Minutes"
27	Subtitle: "Simple, beginner-friendly resistance band exercises to build strength and improve flexibility at home."

# WellSource — Expert health guidance you can trust

## Brand
WellSource is a comprehensive health and wellness media platform delivering medically reviewed content, tools, and resources to empower informed health decisions. The tone is professional, modern, and warm — designed to build trust with general consumers seeking reliable health and wellness information.

Brand colors: #02838D (teal/primary), #231F20 (dark charcoal), #FFFFFF (white)

## Header Navigation
- **Health Conditions** — dropdown mega-menu with subcategories: Breast Cancer, Chronic Kidney Disease, COPD, Digestive Health, Eye Health, Heart Health, Menopause, Mental Health, Migraine, Multiple Sclerosis, Parkinson's Disease, Psoriasis, Rheumatoid Arthritis, Sleep Health, Type 2 Diabetes, Weight Management
- **Wellness** — dropdown with: CBD, Fitness, Healthy Aging, Hearing, Mental Well-Being, Nutrition, Parenthood, Recipes, Sexual Health, Skin Care, Sleep Health, Vitamins and Supplements, Women's Wellness; also Product Reviews and Featured Programs

- **Connect** — Bezzy community links, social media

Secondary actions: Subscribe | Sign In

A continuously scrolling ticker bar displaying:
- Medically reviewed content
- 145 medical reviewers in network
- 21 years of experience
- 55 million monthly readers

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>WellSource — Expert health guidance you can trust</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/remixicon@4.1.0/fonts/remixicon.css" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

:root {
  --primary: #02838D;
  --primary-dark: #026A72;
  --primary-light: #E6F5F6;
  --primary-50: #F0FAFA;
  --charcoal: #231F20;
  --charcoal-light: #4A4546;
  --white: #FFFFFF;
  --gray-50: #FAFAF9;
  --gray-100: #F5F5F4;
  --gray-200: #E7E5E4;
  --gray-300: #D6D3D1;
  --gray-400: #A8A29E;
  --gray-500: #78716C;
  --gray-600: #57534E;
  --coral: #E8635A;
  --coral-dark: #D4504A;
  --coral-light: #FEF0EF;
  --amber: #D4930D;
  --amber-light: #FFF8E6;
  --radius-sm: 8px;
  --radius-md: 12px;
  --radius-lg: 16px;
  --radius-xl: 20px;
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  --shadow-md: 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.07), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  --shadow-lg: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  --shadow-xl: 0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}

html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

body {
  font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  background: var(--white);
  line-height: 1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
button { cursor: pointer; border: none; background: none; font-family: inherit; }
ul { list-style: none; }
img { max-width: 100%; display: block; }

.container {
  max-width: 1240px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 0 24px;
}

/* ===== HEADER ===== */
.header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 1000;
  background: var(--white);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
}

.header-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  height: 64px;
}

.logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  font-size: 22px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--primary);
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
}

.logo i {
  font-size: 26px;
}

.nav-main {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  height: 100%;
}

.nav-item {
  position: relative;
  height: 64px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.nav-link {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  font-size: 14.5px;
  font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  transition: all 0.2s;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.nav-link:hover { background: var(--gray-100); color: var(--primary); }

.nav-link i {
  font-size: 12px;
  transition: transform 0.2s;
}

.nav-item.active .nav-link { color: var(--primary); }
.nav-item.active .nav-link i { transform: rotate(180deg); }

.header-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
}

.btn-subscribe {
  padding: 8px 20px;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: var(--white);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: 50px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.btn-subscribe:hover { background: var(--primary-dark); }

.btn-signin {
  padding: 8px 16px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  border-radius: 50px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.btn-signin:hover { color: var(--primary); }

/* ===== MEGA MENU ===== */
.mega-menu {
  position: absolute;
  top: 64px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: 0 0 var(--radius-lg) var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  border-top: 3px solid var(--primary);
  padding: 28px 32px;
  min-width: 680px;
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(8px);
  transition: all 0.25s ease;
  z-index: 999;
}

.nav-item.active .mega-menu {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
}

.mega-menu-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 6px;
}

.mega-menu-link {
  display: block;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  font-size: 13.5px;
  color: var(--charcoal-light);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  transition: all 0.15s;
}

.mega-menu-link:hover {
  background: var(--primary-light);
  color: var(--primary);
}

.mega-menu-featured {
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding-top: 20px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  display: flex;
  gap: 24px;
}

.mega-menu-featured a {
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--primary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
}

.mega-menu-featured a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

.mega-menu-wide { min-width: 820px; }
.mega-menu-wide .mega-menu-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); }

.mega-menu-narrow { min-width: 360px; }
.mega-menu-narrow .mega-menu-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }

/* ===== CREDIBILITY TICKER ===== */
.ticker-bar {
  background: var(--primary);
  color: var(--white);
  overflow: hidden;
  height: 40px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.ticker-track {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  animation: ticker-scroll 30s linear infinite;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ticker-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 0 32px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 500;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.ticker-item i { font-size: 16px; opacity: 0.9; }

.ticker-separator {
  width: 4px;
  height: 4px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
  border-radius: 50%;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

@keyframes ticker-scroll {
  0% { transform: translateX(0); }
  100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}

/* ===== HERO ===== */
.hero {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--primary-50) 0%, var(--white) 100%);
  padding: 56px 0;
}

.hero-inner {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 48px;
  align-items: center;
}

.hero-content { max-width: 520px; }

.hero-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 6px 14px;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: var(--white);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  border-radius: 50px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.hero-badge i { font-size: 14px; }

.hero-title {
  font-size: 38px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.15;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  letter-spacing: -0.5px;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.hero-subtitle {
  font-size: 17px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--gray-600);
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}

.hero-cta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px 28px;
  background: var(--primary);
  color: var(--white);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: 50px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.hero-cta:hover { background: var(--primary-dark); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }

.hero-visual {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

.hero-image-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 480px;
  aspect-ratio: 4/3;
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  background: linear-gradient(145deg, #B2EBF2 0%, #80DEEA 50%, #4DD0E1 100%);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
}

.hero-image-wrapper::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 60%, rgba(2,131,141,0.15) 100%);
}

.hero-fitness-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: 20px;
  right: 20px;
  z-index: 2;
  background: var(--coral);
  color: var(--white);
  width: 80px;
  height: 80px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
}

.hero-fitness-badge span:first-child {
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1;
}

.hero-fitness-badge span:last-child {
  font-size: 9px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

.hero-fitness-icon {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 24px;
  left: 24px;
  z-index: 2;
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
}

.hero-fitness-icon i { font-size: 28px; color: var(--primary); }

/* ===== TRENDING ===== */
.trending {
  padding: 56px 0;
  background: var(--white);
}

.section-header {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}

.section-title {
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  letter-spacing: -0.3px;
}

.section-link {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--primary);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

.section-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

.trending-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
}

.trending-card {
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  transition: all 0.25s;
  background: var(--white);
}

.trending-card:hover {
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
  transform: translateY(-3px);
}

.trending-card-img {
  height: 160px;
  background: var(--gray-200);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.trending-card-img::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 100%);
}

.trending-card:nth-child(1) .trending-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FDE8E8, #F8B4B4); }
.trending-card:nth-child(2) .trending-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E0F2F1, #A5D6C7); }
.trending-card:nth-child(3) .trending-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF3E0, #FFCC80); }
.trending-card:nth-child(4) .trending-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8EAF6, #B3B9E0); }

.trending-card-img i {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  font-size: 32px;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

.trending-card-body { padding: 16px; }

.trending-card-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  color: var(--primary);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.trending-card-title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--charcoal);
}

/* ===== NEWSLETTER CTA ===== */
.newsletter-cta {
  padding: 64px 0;
  background: var(--primary-light);
}

.newsletter-inner {
  max-width: 640px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  text-align: center;
}

.newsletter-heading {
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  letter-spacing: -0.3px;
}

.newsletter-body {
  font-size: 16px;
  color: var(--gray-600);
  margin-bottom: 28px;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.newsletter-form {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  max-width: 480px;
  margin: 0 auto 12px;
}

.newsletter-input {
  flex: 1;
  padding: 14px 20px;
  border: 2px solid var(--gray-300);
  border-radius: 50px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-family: inherit;
  outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.2s;
  background: var(--white);
}

.newsletter-input:focus { border-color: var(--primary); }

.newsletter-btn {
  padding: 14px 28px;
  background: var(--coral);
  color: var(--white);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: 50px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.newsletter-btn:hover { background: var(--coral-dark); }

.newsletter-privacy {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--gray-500);
}

/* ===== HEALTH TOPICS ===== */
.health-topics {
  padding: 56px 0;
  background: var(--white);
}

.topics-carousel-wrapper {
  position: relative;
}

.topics-carousel {
  display: flex;
  gap: 24px;
  overflow-x: auto;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  scrollbar-width: none;
  -ms-overflow-style: none;
  padding: 8px 0 16px;
}

.topics-carousel::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

.topic-card {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 160px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
  padding: 20px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  transition: all 0.25s;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.topic-card:hover { background: var(--primary-light); transform: translateY(-3px); }

.topic-card-img {
  width: 100px;
  height: 100px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--primary-light);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  transition: all 0.25s;
}

.topic-card:hover .topic-card-img { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--primary); }

.topic-card-img i { font-size: 36px; color: var(--primary); }

.topic-card-label {
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  text-align: center;
}

.carousel-arrow {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
  background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 18px;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
  z-index: 10;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.carousel-arrow:hover { background: var(--primary); color: var(--white); border-color: var(--primary); }
.carousel-arrow.left { left: -16px; }
.carousel-arrow.right { right: -16px; }

.health-tools {

  background: var(--gray-50);

.tools-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 32px;
}

.tools-intro {
  background: var(--primary);
  color: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
  padding: 36px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
}

.tools-intro-icon {
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.tools-intro-icon i { font-size: 24px; }

.tools-intro h3 {
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.tools-intro p {
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  opacity: 0.9;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.tools-intro-cta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 10px 22px;
  background: var(--white);
  color: var(--primary);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: 50px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
  align-self: flex-start;
}

.tools-intro-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); }

.tools-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 14px;
}

.tool-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 18px 20px;
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  transition: all 0.25s;
}

.tool-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); border-color: var(--primary); }

.tool-icon {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.tool-icon.nutrition { background: #FFF3E0; color: #E65100; }
.tool-icon.calculator { background: #E0F2F1; color: #00695C; }
.tool-icon.drug { background: #E8EAF6; color: #283593; }
.tool-icon.pill { background: #FCE4EC; color: #AD1457; }
.tool-icon.glp { background: #FFF8E1; color: #F57F17; }
.tool-icon.care { background: #E8F5E9; color: #2E7D32; }

.tool-icon i { font-size: 22px; }

.tool-info { flex: 1; }

.tool-name {
  font-size: 14.5px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.tool-desc {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: var(--gray-500);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.tool-arrow {
  font-size: 18px;
  color: var(--gray-400);
  transition: all 0.2s;

.reads-tab {

  color: var(--gray-600);
  border-radius: 50px;
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.reads-tab:hover { border-color: var(--primary); color: var(--primary); }

.reads-tab.active {
  background: var(--primary);

  border-color: var(--primary);
}

.reads-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 24px;
}

.read-card {
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  transition: all 0.25s;
  background: var(--white);
}

.read-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-3px); }

.read-card-img {
  height: 180px;
  background: var(--gray-200);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.read-card-img::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 60%, rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 100%);
}

.read-card-img i {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  font-size: 36px;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}

.read-card-body { padding: 18px; }

.read-card-category {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  color: var(--primary);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.read-card-title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.read-card-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--gray-500);
}

.read-card-meta span {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

/* ===== TRUST SECTION ===== */
.trust-section {
  padding: 64px 0;
  background: var(--primary-light);
}

.trust-heading {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  margin-bottom: 40px;
  letter-spacing: -0.3px;
  max-width: 560px;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.trust-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 24px;
}

.trust-card {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 28px 20px;
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: all 0.25s;
}

.trust-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-3px); }

.trust-icon {
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  margin: 0 auto 16px;
  background: var(--primary-light);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.trust-icon i { font-size: 24px; color: var(--primary); }

.trust-title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.trust-desc {
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--gray-600);
}

/* ===== FEATURED PROGRAMS ===== */
.featured-programs {
  padding: 56px 0;
  background: var(--white);
}

.programs-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
}

.program-card {
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  transition: all 0.25s;
  background: var(--white);
}

.program-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-3px); }

.program-card-img {
  height: 150px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.program-card:nth-child(1) .program-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F3E5F5, #CE93D8); }
.program-card:nth-child(2) .program-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E3F2FD, #90CAF9); }
.program-card:nth-child(3) .program-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF3E0, #FFB74D); }
.program-card:nth-child(4) .program-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8F5E9, #81C784); }

.program-card-img i {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  font-size: 32px;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
}

.program-card-body { padding: 16px; }

.program-card-title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ===== LATEST VIDEOS ===== */
.latest-videos {
  padding: 56px 0;
  background: var(--gray-50);
}

.videos-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
}

.video-card {
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  transition: all 0.25s;
  background: var(--white);
}

.video-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-3px); }

.video-card-img {
  height: 150px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--gray-300);
}

.video-card:nth-child(1) .video-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #EFEBE9, #BCAAA4); }
.video-card:nth-child(2) .video-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FCE4EC, #F48FB1); }
.video-card:nth-child(3) .video-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E0F2F1, #80CBC4); }
.video-card:nth-child(4) .video-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8EAF6, #9FA8DA); }

.video-play {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  width: 48px;
  height: 48px;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95);

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);

/* ===== FOOTER ===== */

.footer-btn {

  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: 50px;

.footer-btn:hover { background: var(--primary-dark); }

.footer-divider {

}

.footer-links {
  padding: 32px 0;

  flex-wrap: wrap;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px 24px;
}

.footer-link {
  font-size: 13px;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
  transition: color 0.2s;
}

.footer-link:hover { color: var(--white); }

.footer-separator {
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
  font-size: 13px;
}

.footer-bottom {
  padding: 24px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.footer-legal {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
  max-width: 680px;
}

.footer-social {

}

.footer-social a {
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
  color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
  font-size: 16px;
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.footer-social a:hover { background: var(--primary); color: var(--white); }

<script>
// ===== MEGA MENU =====
(function() {
  const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');
  let activeItem = null;

  navItems.forEach(item => {
    const link = item.querySelector('.nav-link');
    link.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (activeItem === item) {
        closeMenu();
      } else {
        closeMenu();
        item.classList.add('active');
        link.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        activeItem = item;
      }
    });

    item.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
      if (activeItem && activeItem !== item) {
        closeMenu();
        item.classList.add('active');
        item.querySelector('.nav-link').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        activeItem = item;
      }
    });
  });

  function closeMenu() {
    if (activeItem) {
      activeItem.classList.remove('active');
      activeItem.querySelector('.nav-link').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      activeItem = null;
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (!e.target.closest('.nav-item')) {
      closeMenu();
    }
  });
})();

// ===== RECOMMENDED READS TABS =====
(function() {

  const grids = document.querySelectorAll('.reads-grid');

  tabs.forEach(tab => {

      const target = tab.dataset.tab;
      tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      tab.classList.add('active');
      grids.forEach(g => {
        g.setAttribute('data-active', g.dataset.tabContent === target ? 'true' : 'false');

    });

})();

  leftBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {

  });

  rightBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    carousel.scrollBy({ left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });
})();

(function() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
  const nav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
  const icon = btn.querySelector('i');

  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    nav.classList.toggle('open');
    icon.className = nav.classList.contains('open') ? 'ri-close-line' : 'ri-menu-line';
  });
})();

function handleNewsletter(e) {

}

function handleFooterNewsletter(e) {

  btn.textContent = 'Signed Up!';
  input.value = '';
  setTimeout(() => {
    btn.textContent = 'Sign Up';
  }, 3000);
  return false;
}
</script>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>

<style>
*, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

:root {
  --primary: #02838D;
  --primary-dark: #026A72;

}

html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

body {

}

a { text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
button { cursor: pointer; border: none; background: none; font-family: inherit; }

.container {

}

/* ===== HEADER ===== */
.header {

/* ===== MEGA MENU ===== */

/* ===== CREDIBILITY TICKER ===== */

.trust-grid {

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

.trust-icon i { font-size: 24px; color: var(--primary); }

.trust-title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.trust-desc {
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--gray-600);
}

/* ===== FEATURED PROGRAMS ===== */

  padding: 56px 0;
  background: var(--white);
}

  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
}

  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  transition: all 0.25s;
  background: var(--white);
}

.program-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-3px); }

  position: relative;

}

.program-card:nth-child(2) .program-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E3F2FD, #90CAF9); }
.program-card:nth-child(3) .program-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF3E0, #FFB74D); }
.program-card:nth-child(4) .program-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8F5E9, #81C784); }

.program-card-img i {

  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);

.footer-bottom {

.footer-legal {

    link.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (activeItem === item) {
        closeMenu();
      } else {
        closeMenu();
        item.classList.add('active');
        link.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        activeItem = item;
      }

        item.classList.add('active');
        item.querySelector('.nav-link').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        activeItem = item;

      activeItem.querySelector('.nav-link').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

.read-card-meta {

  gap: 12px;

  color: var(--gray-500);
}

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

.trust-heading {

.trust-grid {

  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);

  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);

.trust-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-3px); }

  height: 56px;
  margin: 0 auto 16px;

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.trust-icon i { font-size: 24px; color: var(--primary); }

.trust-title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.trust-desc {
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--gray-600);
}

/* ===== FEATURED PROGRAMS ===== */

  padding: 56px 0;
  background: var(--white);
}

  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
}

.program-card {
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);

  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  transition: all 0.25s;
  background: var(--white);
}

.program-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-3px); }

  position: relative;

}

.program-card:nth-child(2) .program-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E3F2FD, #90CAF9); }
.program-card:nth-child(3) .program-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF3E0, #FFB74D); }
.program-card:nth-child(4) .program-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8F5E9, #81C784); }

.program-card-img i {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);

  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--charcoal);

        link.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');

  height: 48px;

  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  margin-bottom: 20px;

  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.tools-intro p {
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  opacity: 0.9;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.tools-intro-cta {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 10px 22px;
  background: var(--white);
  color: var(--primary);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  border-radius: 50px;

}

.tools-list {

}

.tool-card {

  gap: 16px;
  padding: 18px 20px;

  border-radius: var(--radius-md);

.tool-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); border-color: var(--primary); }

.tool-icon {

.tool-icon.nutrition { background: #FFF3E0; color: #E65100; }
.tool-icon.calculator { background: #E0F2F1; color: #00695C; }
.tool-icon.drug { background: #E8EAF6; color: #283593; }
.tool-icon.pill { background: #FCE4EC; color: #AD1457; }
.tool-icon.glp { background: #FFF8E1; color: #F57F17; }
.tool-icon.care { background: #E8F5E9; color: #2E7D32; }

.tool-icon i { font-size: 22px; }

.tool-info { flex: 1; }

.tool-name {

  color: var(--charcoal);

}

.tool-desc {
  font-size: 13px;

  line-height: 1.4;
}

.tool-arrow {

  color: var(--gray-400);
  transition: all 0.2s;
}

.tool-card:hover .tool-arrow { color: var(--primary); transform: translateX(3px); }

/* ===== RECOMMENDED READS ===== */

  padding: 56px 0;

}

.reads-tab {

}

.reads-grid {
  display: grid;

  gap: 24px;
}

.read-card {

  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  transition: all 0.25s;
  background: var(--white);
}

.read-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-3px); }

.read-card-img {
  height: 180px;
  background: var(--gray-200);

  overflow: hidden;
}

.read-card-img::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 60%, rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 100%);
}

.read-card-img i {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  font-size: 36px;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}

.read-card-body { padding: 18px; }

.read-card-category {

  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;

  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.read-card-title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.read-card-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--gray-500);
}

.read-card-meta span {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
}

/* ===== TRUST SECTION ===== */
.trust-section {
  padding: 64px 0;
  background: var(--primary-light);
}

.trust-heading {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 28px;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  margin-bottom: 40px;
  letter-spacing: -0.3px;
  max-width: 560px;
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  line-height: 1.3;
}

.trust-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 24px;
}

.trust-card {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 28px 20px;
  background: var(--white);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);

}

.trust-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-md); transform: translateY(-3px); }

.trust-icon {

  height: 56px;
  margin: 0 auto 16px;
  background: var(--primary-light);
  border-radius: 50%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.trust-icon i { font-size: 24px; color: var(--primary); }

.trust-title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.trust-desc {
  font-size: 13.5px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--gray-600);
}

/* ===== FEATURED PROGRAMS ===== */
.featured-programs {
  padding: 56px 0;
  background: var(--white);
}

.programs-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 20px;
}

.program-card {
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  transition: all 0.25s;
  background: var(--white);
}

.program-card:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); transform: translateY(-3px); }

.program-card-img {
  height: 150px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.program-card:nth-child(1) .program-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F3E5F5, #CE93D8); }
.program-card:nth-child(2) .program-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E3F2FD, #90CAF9); }
.program-card:nth-child(3) .program-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FFF3E0, #FFB74D); }
.program-card:nth-child(4) .program-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8F5E9, #81C784); }

.program-card-img i {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  font-size: 32px;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
}

.program-card-body { padding: 16px; }

.program-card-title {
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--charcoal);
  line-height: 1.4;
}

  background: var(--gray-50);

  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);

.video-card {

  border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
  transition: all 0.25s;
  background: var(--white);

.video-card:nth-child(1) .video-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #EFEBE9, #BCAAA4); }
.video-card:nth-child(2) .video-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FCE4EC, #F48FB1); }
.video-card:nth-child(3) .video-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E0F2F1, #80CBC4); }
.video-card:nth-child(4) .video-card-img { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E8EAF6, #9FA8DA); }

  left: 50%;

  height: 48px;

.footer-link:hover { color: var(--white); }

.footer-separator {

.footer-bottom {

.footer-legal {

(function() {
  const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');
  let activeItem = null;

  navItems.forEach(item => {
    const link = item.querySelector('.nav-link');
    link.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (activeItem === item) {
        closeMenu();
      } else {
        closeMenu();
        item.classList.add('active');
        link.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        activeItem = item;
      }
    });

    item.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
      if (activeItem && activeItem !== item) {
        closeMenu();
        item.classList.add('active');
        item.querySelector('.nav-link').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        activeItem = item;
      }
    });
  });

  function closeMenu() {
    if (activeItem) {
      activeItem.classList.remove('active');
      activeItem.querySelector('.nav-link').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      activeItem = null;
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    if (!e.target.closest('.nav-item')) {
      closeMenu();
    }
  });
})();

      tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      tab.classList.add('active');
      grids.forEach(g => {
        g.setAttribute('data-active', g.dataset.tabContent === target ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
    });
  });
})();

  const rightBtn = document.getElementById('topicArrowRight');

  leftBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    carousel.scrollBy({ left: -scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });

  rightBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    carousel.scrollBy({ left: scrollAmount, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });
})();

// ===== MOBILE MENU =====
(function() {
  const btn = document.getElementById('mobileMenuBtn');
  const nav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
  const icon = btn.querySelector('i');

  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    nav.classList.toggle('open');
    icon.className = nav.classList.contains('open') ? 'ri-close-line' : 'ri-menu-line';
  });
})();

  const form = e.target;

  const btn = form.querySelector('button');
  btn.textContent = 'Subscribed!';
  btn.style.background = '#2E7D32';
  input.value = '';
  setTimeout(() => {
    btn.textContent = 'Join Now';
    btn.style.background = '';
  }, 3000);
  return false;
}

function handleFooterNewsletter(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const form = e.target;
  const input = form.querySelector('input');
  const btn = form.querySelector('button');
  btn.textContent = 'Signed Up!';
  input.value = '';
  setTimeout(() => {
    btn.textContent = 'Sign Up';
  }, 3000);
  return false;
}
</script>
